description: Test suite for Playwright's network tab filtering and copying functionalities, including multiple test cases verifying network request filtering by resource type, URL, JSON payload formatting, and clipboard copy operations.

methods.name: should filter network requests by resource type
methods.description: Tests filtering network requests by resource type (JS, CSS, Image, Fetch, HTML, Font) in the network tab.

methods.name: should filter network requests by multiple resource types
methods.description: Verifies filtering by multiple resource types simultaneously.

methods.name: should filter network requests by url
methods.description: Tests filtering network requests by URL substring in the network tab.

methods.name: should format JSON request body
methods.description: Checks that JSON payloads are properly formatted in the network panel.

methods.name: should display list of query parameters (only if present)
methods.description: Verifies display of query parameters when present in URL.

methods.name: should not duplicate network entries from beforeAll
methods.description: Ensures network requests are not duplicated when using beforeAll hooks.

methods.name: should toggle sections inside network details
methods.description: Tests collapsing and expanding of network request detail sections.

methods.name: should copy network request
methods.description: Verifies copying network request as cURL, Fetch, and Playwright commands to clipboard.

search-terms: network request filtering by resource type

ctags.name: curlRequest
ctags.pattern: /^    const curlRequest = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__clipboardCall);$/

ctags.name: fetchRequest
ctags.pattern: /^    const fetchRequest = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__clipboardCall);$/

ctags.name: playwrightRequest
ctags.pattern: /^    const playwrightRequest = await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).__clipboardCall);$/

ctags.name: region
ctags.pattern: /^  const region = payloadPanel.getByRole('region', { name: 'Query String Parameters × 3' });$/
